_about: Short descriptions of groups, shown as a one-line subtitle on a search result and searched after the name (labelled 'matched: description'). 'drafts' are written by src/build_group_search.py --draft from existing data (tag descriptions, hand-group notes, the lines of the most popular members) and are flagged auto_described; they are rewritten each time. 'edits' are written by hand, keyed by the same group id, and always win; --draft never touches them. Prefer stable ids (hand:, kw:, rp:, tag:); leaf:, tent: and loose: ids are hashes and can change between builds (about 34 of 1,273 leaf ids did), and an edit whose id vanishes is reported as an orphan on every build.
